evaluation_provenance: Non-paper modern protocol: SB3-Contrib/RL-Zoo versioned recommendation; paper does not specify evaluation frequency, episode count, or evaluation environment count.
max_steps_provenance: Non-paper pilot cap: 100,000 environment steps, reaching the paper BRN warm-up threshold; not the paper's 5,000,000-step endpoint.

pilot.purpose: Resource and stability pilot only; not full performance reproduction.

actor_architecture.provenance: SB3-Contrib 2.9.0 documented default; not specified by the paper.

entropy_coefficient.provenance: Modern SB3 default; not specified by the paper.

learning_starts.provenance: Modern SB3 default; not specified by the paper.
